raw_prompt: !update change the tnt bow to only spawn 100 tnt
reviewer_feedback: Updated the TNT Bow to spawn exactly 100 TNT blocks upon impact instead of the previous amount.
usage_instructions: Use /give-tnt-bow to receive the explosive bow (requires OP).
Shoot an arrow at a block to trigger the 100 TNT explosion.

mutations.content:
on shoot:
    if shooter is a player:
        if name of shooter's tool is "&cTNT Bow":
            set metadata "is_tnt_arrow" of projectile to "true"

on projectile hit:
    if metadata "is_tnt_arrow" of projectile is "true":
        loop 100 times:
            spawn primed tnt at location of projectile
        delete projectile

command /give-tnt-bow:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give player a bow named "&cTNT Bow" with lore "&7Shoots 100 explosive TNT arrows."

traces.intent_summary: Limit the TNT bow to spawn exactly 100 TNT entities upon firing.

traces.rationale: Updated the loop count from 100000 to 100 to prevent server lag and fulfill the user request. Maintained the metadata-based identification system as it is the standard way to track projectiles in vanilla Skript without addons.
